title: Architecture Discovery Brief
use_when: Use before designing or changing a system when the actual operating environment is not yet understood.

title: Current-State Architecture Assessment
use_when: Use to determine whether an existing platform is fit for its present and expected workload.

title: Target-State Architecture Design
use_when: Use when a future-state platform must be designed from business outcomes and verified constraints.

title: Integration and API Boundary Design
use_when: Use to design reliable interfaces between internal systems, vendors, banks, CRMs, proposal tools, or custom services.

title: Event-Driven Architecture Design
use_when: Use when workflows need asynchronous processing, decoupling, auditability, or high-volume coordination.

title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture
use_when: Use to design or audit tenant isolation, scale, customization, and operations for a shared platform.

title: Resilience and Failure-Domain Review
use_when: Use to find hidden single points of failure and verify recovery behavior.

title: Cloud Migration Architecture
use_when: Use to move applications or data with controlled risk and measurable cutover criteria.

title: Architecture Decision Record Director
use_when: Use to convert an architecture debate into a durable, auditable decision record.

title: Build, Buy, or Partner Decision
use_when: Use for high-value platform, vendor, or capability sourcing decisions.

title: Repository Orientation and Change Map
use_when: Use before modifying an unfamiliar or complex codebase.

title: Implementation Plan Director
use_when: Use to turn a product or technical requirement into an executable engineering plan.

title: Risk-First Code Review
use_when: Use to review a change for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational impact.

title: Root-Cause Analysis for Software Failures
use_when: Use when symptoms, logs, and recent changes must be converted into a defensible cause analysis.

title: Refactoring Strategy
use_when: Use when code quality must improve without destabilizing production behavior.

title: Test Architecture and Coverage Plan
use_when: Use to design test coverage around risk rather than raw test count.

title: Performance Diagnosis
use_when: Use to investigate latency, throughput, memory, CPU, database, or scaling problems.

title: Dependency Upgrade and Compatibility Plan
use_when: Use to upgrade frameworks, runtimes, libraries, or SDKs safely.

title: Release Readiness Review
use_when: Use immediately before deploying a material software change.

title: Observability Architecture
use_when: Use to make a system diagnosable and operable before incidents occur.

title: API Implementation Contract
use_when: Use before coding a new endpoint or revising a public or internal contract.

title: Patch Verification and Regression Gate
use_when: Use after a bug or security fix to determine whether the patch actually resolves the cause without new defects.

title: Product Requirements Director
use_when: Use to convert a product concept into an implementable and testable product requirements document.

title: Customer Journey and UX Audit
use_when: Use to diagnose friction across a complete user journey rather than one screen.

title: Information Architecture Design
use_when: Use to structure navigation, content, permissions, or complex application areas.

title: Design System Foundation
use_when: Use to create or rationalize a reusable visual and interaction system.

title: Frontend Visual Direction and Build Brief
use_when: Use to direct a polished frontend implementation without micromanaging every CSS rule.

title: Accessibility Review Director
use_when: Use to audit a website, application, document, or workflow for barriers and remediation priorities.

title: Conversion Experience Review
use_when: Use to improve a landing page, signup, lead form, checkout, or appointment flow while preserving trust.

title: Design QA and Visual Acceptance Gate
use_when: Use before releasing a visual artifact, interface, document, or campaign asset.

title: Data Pipeline Architecture
use_when: Use to design ingestion, transformation, storage, serving, and governance for a data flow.

title: Schema and Data Contract Design
use_when: Use to define durable structures shared across databases, APIs, events, and analytics.

title: Data Quality Control Plan
use_when: Use when reports, automations, models, or integrations depend on trustworthy data.

title: Workflow Automation Architecture
use_when: Use to automate a business process across systems without creating hidden fragility.

title: Tool and Agent Routing Design
use_when: Use to decide when a model should reason, retrieve, call tools, run code, or seek approval.

title: Idempotency, Retry, and Dead-Letter Design
use_when: Use to make integrations and automations safe under duplicate delivery and partial failure.

title: Cross-System Reconciliation Design
use_when: Use when two or more systems may disagree about transactions, projects, customers, or workflow state.

title: Automation Cost and Ownership Review
use_when: Use to compare subscription automation, custom integration, managed service, and owned infrastructure.

title: CTO Decision Memorandum
use_when: Use to present a material technical decision to executives or investors.

title: CISO Risk Memorandum
use_when: Use to communicate a security risk, exception, control gap, or investment decision to leadership.

title: Architecture Review Board Package
use_when: Use to prepare a proposal for formal technical governance.

title: Technical Vendor Due Diligence
use_when: Use before selecting, investing in, or integrating a technology vendor.

title: Technical Roadmap and Investment Prioritization
use_when: Use to sequence platform, product, security, and operational investments.

title: Program Recovery Plan
use_when: Use when a technical program is late, unstable, over budget, or losing stakeholder confidence.

title: Executive Incident Briefing
use_when: Use during or after a material outage or security incident to communicate clearly to leadership.

title: Technology Operating Review
use_when: Use for weekly, monthly, or quarterly leadership review of delivery, reliability, security, cost, and capability.

title: Defensive Authorization and Scope Charter
use_when: Use before any advanced security review, test, investigation, or purple-team exercise.

title: Enterprise Threat Model
use_when: Use to model organization-level cyber risk across business services, identities, data, vendors, and operations.

title: Application Threat Model
use_when: Use during design or major change to identify application-specific abuse and attack paths.

title: Security Architecture Review
use_when: Use to assess whether a proposed or existing architecture has adequate defense in depth.

title: Secure Code Review
use_when: Use for authorized review of code for exploitable defects and insecure design.

title: Authorization and Access-Control Review
use_when: Use to review object, function, field, tenant, and administrative authorization.

title: Authentication and Session Security Review
use_when: Use to review login, account recovery, MFA, tokens, sessions, and identity-provider integration.

title: Input Validation and Injection Review
use_when: Use to review how untrusted data reaches interpreters, queries, templates, commands, or downstream services.

title: File Upload and Storage Security Review
use_when: Use to review user-supplied files, archives, media, documents, and object storage.

title: API Security Assessment
use_when: Use to assess an API against its actual business flows and the OWASP API risk categories.

title: Webhook Security Review
use_when: Use to secure inbound and outbound webhook integrations.

title: Cloud IAM and Privilege Review
use_when: Use to review users, roles, service identities, policies, and privileged paths in a cloud environment.

title: Secrets Management Review
use_when: Use to evaluate application, CI/CD, infrastructure, and operator secret handling.

title: Tenant Isolation Security Review
use_when: Use to verify isolation across customers, organizations, workspaces, or projects.

title: Software Supply-Chain Review
use_when: Use to assess dependencies, provenance, builds, packages, and release artifacts.

title: CI/CD Pipeline Security Review
use_when: Use to evaluate source-to-production permissions, runners, secrets, approvals, and artifacts.

title: Container and Orchestration Security Review
use_when: Use to assess container images, runtime configuration, Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration.

title: Security Logging and Detection Coverage Review
use_when: Use to determine whether relevant security events are visible and actionable.

title: Vulnerability Triage and Prioritization
use_when: Use to convert scanner, disclosure, or code-review findings into business-prioritized remediation.

title: Security Patch Design
use_when: Use to design a fix for a verified security defect.

title: Security Patch Validation
use_when: Use after remediation to prove that a vulnerability is closed and no regression was introduced.

title: Incident Triage and Containment Plan
use_when: Use at the start of a suspected security incident.

title: Incident Timeline and Scope Reconstruction
use_when: Use to build a defensible incident timeline from logs, alerts, tickets, and system evidence.

title: Detection Engineering Rule Design
use_when: Use to turn a threat hypothesis into a testable detection and response rule.

title: Authorized Purple-Team Exercise Plan
use_when: Use to plan a bounded exercise that validates preventive, detective, and response controls.

title: Cybersecurity Tabletop Exercise
use_when: Use to rehearse decision-making, communications, and recovery without technical execution.

title: Security Control Mapping and Evidence Plan
use_when: Use to map system evidence to NIST, contractual, or internal control outcomes.

title: Privacy and Data Security Review
use_when: Use to assess personal, confidential, regulated, or sensitive data across collection, processing, sharing, retention, and deletion.

title: AI and LLM Application Security Review
use_when: Use to assess an application that uses models, agents, tools, retrieval, memory, or connected data.

title: Security Release Gate
use_when: Use before releasing a high-impact application, integration, model workflow, or infrastructure change.

title: Evidence-Based Research Synthesis
use_when: Use to answer a complex question from web, files, connected data, and primary sources.

title: Professional Document Production Director
use_when: Use to turn content and evidence into a polished report, handbook, SOP, proposal, or PDF.

title: Executive Presentation Production Director
use_when: Use to create a decision-oriented presentation rather than a text-heavy document placed on slides.

title: Spreadsheet Model and Analysis Director
use_when: Use to create a financial, operational, planning, tracking, or analytical workbook.

title: Purple Team Program Charter
use_when: Establish the mandate, outcomes, authority, funding, independence, and review cadence.

title: Authorization and Rules of Engagement
use_when: Create the controlling authorization record before any active security validation.

title: Target Manifest and Data Handling Plan
use_when: Bind an exercise to exact assets and protect sensitive evidence.

title: Safety Risk and Deconfliction Plan
use_when: Prevent operational harm and collisions with real incidents or maintenance.

title: Threat-Informed Objective Selection
use_when: Convert enterprise risk and threat evidence into bounded test objectives.

title: ATT&CK Coverage Hypothesis
use_when: Map behaviors to current ATT&CK objects without claiming coverage from labels alone.

title: Scenario and Control Objective Design
use_when: Build a realistic scenario as a sequence of defensive questions, not an unrestricted attack chain.

title: Technique-to-Telemetry Mapping
use_when: Prove that each planned test has observable evidence before execution.

title: Lab and Range Readiness
use_when: Confirm an isolated environment can safely support the planned validation.

title: Atomic Test Run Card
use_when: Convert one approved behavior into a controlled, observable, reversible run card.

title: Tooling and Operator Approval Gate
use_when: Approve a tool and operator combination for one bounded exercise.

title: Stop, Abort, and Rollback Control
use_when: Make safety controls executable before the first active test.

title: Telemetry Readiness Review
use_when: Validate that sensors and data pipelines can support the exercise.

title: Detection Engineering Validation
use_when: Evaluate whether an analytic detects the intended behavior with acceptable noise.

title: Alert Triage and Response Observation
use_when: Measure the human and automated response path after a controlled signal.

title: Prevention and Resilience Validation
use_when: Determine whether preventive controls block safely and services remain resilient.

title: Purple Test Orchestration Plan
use_when: Coordinate approved red action, blue observation, safety, evidence, and decisions.

title: Evidence Ledger and Finding Normalization
use_when: Create traceable evidence without overstating results.

title: Remediation and Retest Plan
use_when: Turn validated gaps into owned corrective action and proof of closure.

title: After-Action Review and CAPA
use_when: Capture learning, corrective action, and accountable follow-through.

title: Coverage and Confidence Scorecard
use_when: Measure defensive confidence without reducing it to ATT&CK color coverage.

title: Program Metrics and Executive Brief
use_when: Report program value, risk reduction, and constraints to accountable leaders.

title: Independent Assurance and Release Gate
use_when: Decide whether the exercise record supports release, closure, or further work.

title: Curriculum and Competency Assessment
use_when: Build role-based purple-team education with safe practical assessment.
